title: Origin
html:
• Saṁyutta Nikāya 47.42 Linked Discourses 47.42
  • 5. Amatavagga 5. Freedom From Death

Samudayasutta Origin

“Catunnaṁ, bhikkhave, satipaṭṭhānānaṁ samudayañca atthaṅgamañca desessāmi. “Mendicants, I will teach you the origin and disappearance of the four kinds of mindfulness meditation. Taṁ suṇātha. Listen …

Ko ca, bhikkhave, kāyassa samudayo? What is the origin of the body? Āhārasamudayā kāyassa samudayo; The body originates from fuel. āhāranirodhā kāyassa atthaṅgamo. When fuel ceases, the body disappears.

Phassasamudayā vedanānaṁ samudayo; Feelings originate from contact. phassanirodhā vedanānaṁ atthaṅgamo. When contact ceases, feelings disappear.

Nāmarūpasamudayā cittassa samudayo; The mind originates from name and form. nāmarūpanirodhā cittassa atthaṅgamo. When name and form cease, the mind disappears.

Manasikārasamudayā dhammānaṁ samudayo; Principles originate from application of mind. manasikāranirodhā dhammānaṁ atthaṅgamo”ti. When application of mind disappears, principles disappear.”

Dutiyaṁ.
